run_animate_face: run animate_face.py with an audio file and face template to generate a talking face video
run_renderer_to_video: run Renderer.to_video to render animated mesh vertices into an MP4 video with audio
run_vertex_unet: run VertexUnet on template geometry and context codes to predict animated face mesh vertices
run_context_model_sample: run ContextModel.sample on audio encodings to produce one-hot context codes for animation
run_multimodal_encoder: run MultimodalEncoder.audio_encoder on chunked audio to extract audio encoding codes
